messages:
mica: Quick sync request Customer Z needs predictable public egress during hosted->VPC move. They cannot update allowlists on partner side. Thoughts?
raj: We currently assign ephemeral NATs. Preserving egress could be a per-tenant reservation model.
ashley: Compliance + billing: we must have explicit consent and a surcharge for reserved addresses. Also audit logs for every egress mapping.
infra-bot: infra note: no current feature to pin NATs across migration. Manual process exists but not automated. Suggest building a reservation service tied to tenant metadata.
sam: UX: surface this as an opt-in toggle in deploy manifest and show expiration in Console with renew button.
mica: Proposed acceptance criteria:
- manifest flag `network.pin_egress_ip`
- reservation lifecycle (alloc, reserve N days, expire with notifications)
- console & API to list reserved IPs and expiry
- migration job emits `reservation_id` and links to tenant audit log
- documented rollback path and customer-facing FAQ
raj: Implementation note: pool management needed. Add alert when reserved usage >75%. Also support manual extension flow for pilot.
ashley: Legal: add clause to onboarding that reserves may incur fees and customer is responsible for partner allowlist updates.
infra-bot: dev ask: migration job will need to lock IPs in allocator and tag them with `pinned=true`. We'll add an S3 audit export encrypted with KMS.
sam: I'll mock small Console panel and notify product when ready for copy.
mica: OK. Raj to estimate infra work; Sam to prototype UI; Ashley to draft billing/legal text. Sync tomorrow 11am PT.
